data.summary: Reviews show strong signals of authenticity (specific names, varied projects, long business history) but the perfect Google/Angi ratings with no critical reviews in the sample and the Yelp discrepancy raise mild concerns about potential review solicitation. No clear complaint patterns or warranty issues detected.
fake_signals: Google reviews are all 5-star in sample, lack critical details
Yelp rating discrepancy with low review count
Some Google reviews mention non-roofing services (Christmas lights, shed) which could indicate review padding
authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Nick, Silvio, Bryce, Teresa)
Varied project types described (roof, shed, fence, interior)
Company has been in business for 15 years
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google and Angi show near-perfect ratings (4.9/5, 5/5) with high volume, while Yelp shows a lower 3.7 with only 3 reviews. This suggests potential review solicitation on Google/Angi or Yelp's different user base and stricter filtering.

I am very happy with the work Discount Roofing did on my roof. The roofers were very responsive to my needs and careful all the way around with tarping my house,  the cleanup and a tightly sealed roof. The quality of their work is outstanding.
The contrast of my new roof blends in nicely with the exterior of my home. I feel like a got a new house ( and my neighbors liked it too).

They completed the job quickly and also started on a separate contracting job inside the house.

I liked that Nick was always available to give me a report and answer questions. The office staff worked hard to follow up with the insurance claims adjuster and I’m appreciative of their eagle-eye to clear up any discrepancies.

Overall I am happy with the reliability of Nick and his team and would hire Discount Roofing again for other contracting services they offer. I highly recommend Discount Roofing.
reviews.author: Olga Terrell
